description_en: Modifies the backup policy of a PolarDB instance
kebab_example: aliyun dbs modify-backup-policy --region-code cn-shanghai --preferred-backup-window-begin 17:00Z --instance-name pc-2ze3nrr64c50000 --category Flash --advance-log-policies LogRetentionType=Never DestType=level1 FilterType=crontab ActionType=CREATE SrcRegion=cn-hangzhou EnableLogBackup=1 SrcType=db LogRetentionValue=30 PolicyId=31289676-bb8d-4dee-b83e-000000 FilterKey=dayOfMonth DestRegion=cn-hangzhou FilterValue=1 --advance-data-policies ActionType=UPDATE StorageClass=Standard RetentionValue=4 FilterKey=backupInterval FilterValue=180 DestType=level1 FilterType=crontab SrcRegion=cn-shanghai SrcType=db OnlyPreserveOneEachDay=true PolicyId=6s67c7i3y8f8p72808p000000 DestRegion=cn-shanghai RetentionType=delay --advance-inc-policies DestType=level1 FilterType=crontab ActionType=CREATE SrcRegion=cn-hangzhou SrcType=db OnlyPreserveOneEachDay=true RetentionValue=365 PolicyId=1 FilterKey=dayOfMonth DestRegion=cn-hangzhou FilterValue=1 RetentionType=delay --backup-retention-policy-on-cluster-deletion 0 --backup-method logical --backup-priority 2 --enable-inc-backup true --backup-retention-period 7 --high-frequency-bak-interval 120 --enable-log-backup 1 --log-backup-retention 7 --log-backup-local-retention-number 10 --local-log-retention-space 30 --high-space-usage-protection enable --inc-backup-interval 120 --enable-pitr-protection true --preferred-backup-date 1111111 --log-backup-local-retention 7 --cold-retention 10 --cold-keep-count 1 --cold-keep-policy 0 --api-version 2021-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region where the backup set resides

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:
Flash: backup within seconds
Standard: basic backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型
Flash：秒级备份
Standard：普通备份

element_fields.help_en:
The retention period type. Valid values:
Never: never expires
Delay: expires after a fixed number of days

   Delay - 固定天数过期

level2: secondary backup
level2Cross: secondary cross-region backup

parameters.help_en: The destination region of the backup policy
parameters.name: advance_inc_policies

parameters.help_en:
The archive backup data retention policy for deleted instances. Valid values:

NONE: Not retained.
LATEST: Only the last backup is retained.
ALL: All backups are retained
parameters.help_zh:
已删除实例的归档备份保留策略，返回值如下：

NONE：不保留
LATEST：保留最后一个
ALL：全部保留
parameters.name: backup_retention_policy_on_cluster_deletion

parameters.help_en:
The backup method. Valid values:
logical: logical backup
physical: physical backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份方式，取值如下：
logical：逻辑备份
physical：物理备份
parameters.name: backup_method

parameters.help_en:
The backup policy for the secondary instance. Valid values:

1: Secondary instance preferred.
2: Primary instance forced.


This parameter applies only to ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. For other engines, the value 0 is returned
parameters.help_zh:
备库备份的设置策略，返回值如下：

1：优先备库
2：强制主库


该参数仅适用于RDS SQL Server实例，其他引擎返回值为0
parameters.name: backup_priority

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable incremental backup
parameters.name: enable_inc_backup

parameters.help_zh: 高频备份时间，分钟为单位，例如 120 表示每两小时备份一次
parameters.name: high_frequency_bak_interval

parameters.help_zh: 是否开启日志备份 1开 0关
parameters.name: enable_log_backup

parameters.help_zh: 本地日志最大空间使用率
parameters.name: local_log_retention_space

parameters.help_zh:
实例使用空间大于 80%，或者剩余空间小于 5 GB 时，是否强制清理日志：
disable：不清理
enable：清理
parameters.name: high_space_usage_protection

parameters.help_zh: 高频增量备份间隔,单位分钟
parameters.name: inc_backup_interval

parameters.help_zh: 是否开启任意时间点保护
parameters.name: enable_pitr_protection

parameters.help_zh: 本地日志保留时间,单位秒
